title: 84. I cannot unzip my exported files
intent: This troubleshooting article helps EUSurvey survey managers resolve or understand the issue: I cannot unzip my exported files.
short_answer: This might happen if the name of the files contained in your folder is too long. Windows has a maximum length of 260 characters for directory locations on the hard drive. Possible solutions for this are:
procedure: Unzip the folder in the root directory of your operating system, e.g. unpack at 'C:' instead of 'C:\Users\USERNAME\Desktop' Or when unpacking the files, rename the target folder to shorten the directory length.
